explication: TOAST UI ImageEditor is a browser-based HTML5 Canvas editor, with plain JavaScript, Vue, and React packages. A user supplies an image and invokes editing operations through the editor; the documented capabilities include crop, transform, drawing, shapes, icons, text, masks, filters, history, and download. The sampled core constructor shows it wiring UI, action, and command-invocation layers, while the Vue wrapper constructs and exposes the editor instance. Several feature modules are represented from the tree and README; their internal call paths were not sampled, so those links are omitted.
